text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this ain't good. It's like my body 
doesn't even belong to me anymore. It's 
shaking all over...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, you're joking, right? You 
think this great Inari would ever cower 
right before a festival?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...I'm itching for action. I just can't 
help it...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"You'll be the very first one I treat to 
the taste of victory, Trainer! Just sit 
tight and look forward to it!"
